digest.component_or_area: LLM code-review concurrency overlay eval spec
propositions: A standing eval spec for the concurrency overlay is missing, risking silent regression of prompt recall/precision behavior established against traced production race conditions.

The spec must define gating recall cases (R1: unlocked twin, R2: TOCTOU), gating no-fire cases (F1: added lock, F2: atomic-write conversion, F3: deliberate probe-then-skip), and a non-gating documented stretch (R3: fail-open guard).

The spec must enforce that a gating deterministic scorer passes an epoch iff every applicable case passes; an epoch passes iff coverage_ok AND all gating scorers pass; only gate: at_least(2) over epochs: 3 provides per-run tolerance.
The spec must distill dataset entries from traced commit provenance (9ad46965bd, 56e130ff71, 7853af7698, 95f97cbeb6, abbc65adf4, 3938c7ed2d) as minimal diff hunks, not full historical replays.

Validation requires rebar prompt eval code-review-concurrency to exit 0 and the spec to meet packaged-spec discipline (unique ids, valid expect vocabulary, balanced fire/pass dataset, non-empty gold_set).
